title: Filtering and Sorting
description: Apply filters and sorting to Prisma queries for precise data retrieval.

data.text: Prisma Client's `where` clause supports rich filtering, including equality, comparisons, pattern matching, and logical operators. The `orderBy` clause controls how results are sorted.
